abandoned_shapes.label: probe-l2-one-diagram-tb

This is why one C4 level ships as two container diagrams.

budget_note: The contract's three-candidate budget per rendered diagram is exceeded: six canvas candidates (three accepted-path repairs, three shape probes) plus two single-diagram probes.
